data.description: A master-planned waterfront address in Dubailand that combines natural serenity with urban comfort. Home to world-inspired clusters, luxury homes, and family-friendly amenities designed for island living.

data.answer: The DAMAC Islands community promises an elevated living standard with a focus on nature, recreation, and wellness. Residents will enjoy amenities such as the central hub fountain, water platforms with social areas, an aqua dome with underwater dining, a jungle river trail, lagoon waterfalls, a hot springs spa, and fitness zones including calisthenics and yoga parks. DAMAC Islands will feature villas and townhouses designed to bring nature closer to home. These properties for sale in Dubai include open layouts, tropical-inspired finishes, and direct lagoon views, blending luxury and lifestyle seamlessly.

Buying a Property in DAMAC Islands

Properties for sale in DAMAC Islands include 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses and 5, 6, and 7-bedroom villas. These homes combine generous layouts with lagoon-facing designs, appealing to homeowners and investors seeking premium waterfront residences.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

data.content:
Located in Dubailand, DAMAC Islands is an upcoming residential community by DAMAC Properties, close to the intersection of Al Qudra Road (D63) and Emirates Road (E611). This off-plan development offers an exclusive selection of villas and townhouses surrounded by lagoons, lush landscapes, and tropical design elements inspired by world-famous island destinations.

The community includes six themed clusters: Maldives, Bora Bora, Fiji, Hawaii, Bali, and Seychelles. Each cluster is inspired by its tropical namesake and designed to capture the atmosphere of relaxed island living through modern layouts and nature-infused surroundings.

Following the strong response to its initial launch, DAMAC Islands Phase 2 has also been introduced, bringing more waterfront homes and lifestyle opportunities. With its resort-style amenities and premium location, the development is set to become one of Dubai’s most distinctive off-plan communities.
